notes.title: 23rd April - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38214508/c15ffb4d6bca994c72a6b214b65bf694f3c32199.png[/img]

Hello Tennis Fans, 

We've pushed out an update that should improve your play experience, with the goal of resolving some of the issues  that arose following the previous patch.

Additionally, there are some further gameplay tweaks which should make the game feel more competitive.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list][*] Added additional sponsors to ad boards.
[*] Added Sharapova exertion sounds.
[*] Re-implemented camera switch option.
[*] Improved doubles player movement and positioning.
[*] Improved crowd visuals and animations.
[*] Improved net play.
[*] Balanced drop shot success rate and landing zone.
[*] Corrected non-progression issues in career mode.
[*] Corrected umpire score announcements.
[*] Corrected ball bounce sounds.
[*] Corrected a case where the ball could pass through the net on ATP Court.[/list]

notes.title: Signature Player Moves + Graphical / Gameplay Updates + More in Latest Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38214508/95efa626badbada9b117b39b8788ba67bf520dce.jpg[/img]

Hello, 

We're introducing one of the largest patches seen for Tennis World Tour 2 yet, bringing in graphical improvements, gameplay changes, signature players moves for a number of pros on the roster and much more. 

Ace Edition and Annual Pass owners will have a lot more to look forward to with the addition of the Champions Pack DLC which brings in the ATP Cup, adding 6 new players to the roster and new stadiums to play in.

Lastly, we're introducing an Esports mode which will allow you to run and create your own tournaments or join and compete on the courts of Tennis World Tour 2.

Read on for more details about the patch then dive in and let us know what you think! 

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list][*] Doubles added to career mode.
[*] 15 new unique pro player animation profile styles have been added.
[*] An integrated first time user experience has been added to ease the learning curve of Tennis World Tour 2
[*] An Esports mode has been added to the game
[*] Stability during online play has been improved
[*] General performance has been improved
[*] Player visuals have been updated and should feel a lot more realistic
[*] Stadium visuals and lighting have been improved.
[*] Increased polygons on the crowd and now have material maps and normal maps (better texture) for a look up to a similar level as the players.
[*] Additional skill cards have been added
[*] Content for Champions Pack. (Ace Edition / Annual Pass / Champions pack DLC owners only)[list]
[*] The ATP Cup
[*] 6 additional players: Andy Murray, Donna Vekic, Marin Cilic, Justine Henin, Maria Sharapova and Diego Schwartzman
[*] 4 additional stadiums in London and Melbourne
[*] Extra official outfits and equipment[/list][/list]
[h3]The Champions Pack is the latest DLC released for Tennis World Tour.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1455641/Tennis_World_Tour_2__Champions_Pack/
[h3]The Champions Pack is ALSO a part of the Tennis World Tour Annual Pass.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397480/Tennis_World_Tour_2_Annual_Pass/

notes.title: Patch 5 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38214508/f5d0fe417fc104c900bdd68cb3d08c8638b6c564.png[/img]

Hello, 

There was a slight delay in the release of Kenin and Pliskova; these two players will be released at a later date. However, we still wanted to push out the patch that was planned to release alongside these players; this includes some changes designed to improve doubles and net play. Let us know what you think of these changes.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list][*] Added rematch option for exhibition mode matches.
[*] Added "No Input" feedback for shots played without input.
[*] Added more audio settings.
[*] Added monitor select
[*] Tuned second serve accuracy on max power serves.
[*] Tuned grunts on slice shots.
[*] Improved doubles.
[*] Improved net play.
[*] Improved underarm serve animation.
[*] Increased XP rewards for lower tier career matches.
[*] Appropriate animation chosen for drop shots.
[*] Corrected occasional “This Is Mine Trophy/Achievement” issue.
[*] Corrected camera switching in local multiplayer.
[*] General stability improvements.[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.04 Notes
notes.content:
Apologies for the delay in publishing the notes, we'll be sure to publish alongside the update next time. 

Our first patch was aimed at addressing a few bugs and feedback from players, including the highly requested option to disable skill cards. We're already at work on the next patch, so we'll be back soon. 

Read on for the full notes:
[h1]Patch 1.04 Notes[/h1][list]
[*] Player ratings have been adjusted
[*] Career difficulty will now be remembered when changed in career mode
[*] Added options to switch camera end
[*] Added option to disable skill cards
[*] Improved serve accuracy for well-timed serves
[*] Improved animation choice on various shots
[*] Improvements to court and ball audio
[*] Improvements to crowd visuals
[*] Tuned AI fault rate
[*] Tuned dropshot range
[*] Corrected optional stamina bar display
[*] Appropriate objectives shown
[*] Present skill cards in AI vs AI match
[*] General stability improvements[/list]

notes.title: Tennis World Tour 2 Out Now - Early Bird Discount Available!
notes.content:
Tennis World Tour 2 is now available on Steam! Play as the top ATP and WTA athletes, or create your own, dominate singles or doubles, local or online play, and climb to Rank 1. Additionally, there are savings to be had if you pick up the game before October 1st. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38214508/aac6a3f1fbdab29c6a64d6e0cc9a950a00f9d42e.jpg[/img]

There are two editions of Tennis World Tour 2. The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1223910/Tennis_World_Tour_2/?beta=0]base version[/url] includes 36 players, career and online modes, and everything you'd expect from a top tier Tennis game.

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15897/Tennis_World_Tour_2_Ace_Edition/]Ace Edition[/url] includes everything above as well as the official tournaments and stadia pack, and the annual pass, a suite of continued updates and new content to TWT2 (including new official players). Annual Pass updates will be released alongside updates and improvements to all versions of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38214508/022f8ebd157129ca353af74e47ebe02f8365771f.jpg[/img]

The Official Tournaments and Stadium Pack includes, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361311/Tennis_World_Tour_2_Official_Tournaments_and_Stadia_Pack/?beta=0]can be purchased separately:[/url]
[list][*] The Roland-Garros tournament with the Philippe-Chatrier, Suzanne-Lenglen, and Simonne-Mathieu stadiums
[*] The main court of the Madrid Open, the Estadio Manolo Santana
[*] The main court of the Halle Open, the OWL ARENA
[*] The Tie Break Tens tournament[/list]
Additionally, since pre-orders were not available for the Steam version of Tennis World Tour, we have made the pre-order DLC (the legendary players Gustavo Kuerten and Marat Safin) available as a free download on Steam. The Legends Pack will go live on September 24th, 5 pm CEST and you'll have until Oct 7, 4:59 pm CEST to download these players free of charge.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361310/Tennis_World_Tour_2_Legends_Pack/
